mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, we are looking at clear skies and a pleasant 73 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park, with the moon currently in a waxing gibbous phase.

The Verona Police Department has published its weekly recap of service calls occurring between August 17 and August 24. This report highlights various incidents including traffic citations, assist calls, and property checks to keep our community informed.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, with even more events like Dream Day Trivia and the Downtown Farmer's Market following on Tuesday.
One of the notable calls from the past week occurred on August 22, when officers responded to a vehicle crash on Enterprise Drive that resulted in multiple citations for the driver.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by soon to grab a scoop before they close.
